results.content: • Papers that present integrated sets of studies that address significant theoretical issues relating to personality. The *Journal of Research in Personality* (JRP) publishes both theoretical and empirical work in the traditional areas of personality (including both trait and dynamic process-oriented approaches) and in related areas central to the study of personality. JRP publishes integrated sets of studies addressing important theoretical or conceptual issues, as well as theoretical and methodological review articles that have the potential to advance the field. In addition to encouraging substantively and theoretically novel papers, JRP encourages submissions that use strong and innovative methodologies, such as longitudinal studies, diary studies, experiments, or quasi-experiments, as well as those that use non-self-report data (e.g., other reports, implicit methods, narratives). In short, JRP seeks to continue its tradition of publishing top tier, traditional personality research, while establishing a lively forum in which well-done studies of a slightly riskier nature will find a comfortable home.

results.content: # Big Five Personality Test. This free personality test gives you accurate scores for the Big Five personality traits. The Big Five describes personality traits along five common dimensions: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism. ## What is the Big Five Personality Test? When you take a Big Five test, you will receive scores for five dimensions of personality:. This makes the Big Five model distinct from many pop psychology systems that classify people in terms of personality "types." In a Big Five test, rather than being sorted into types, people are described in terms of how they compare with the average across each of the five personality traits. ## Big Five Personality Test FAQ.
